name: Login.gov OpenID Connect
description: OpenID Connect client plugin for Login.gov.
project_description:
The Login.gov module adds support to OpenID Connect / OAuth 2.0 for authenticating against login.gov, including requiring MFA or PIV/CAC.

 You will need a sandbox account with the Login.gov sandbox environment . See the Getting Started with Login.gov documentation for more information.

 Patches 
 No patching of the OpenID Connect/OAuth 2.0 module is required at this point. The 3.0.0-alpha3 release contains the required patch.
